name: session-lens
description: A session lens pane (/lens): Claude's to-do list, its crew of subagents as animated crabs with a progress band above the prompt, and the skills and tools this session used, each section folding on its own. Replaces crab-crew: disable or don't install crab-crew alongside it.

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: In the desktop app, open the lens the first time a session uses a tool or a skill

crewBand.title: Crew band above the prompt
crewBand.description: While subagents are out, show their crabs and how far along they are just above the prompt

hidePlanRows.title: Hide the plan's rows in the chat
hidePlanRows.description: While the lens is open in front with To-do unfolded, hide the TodoWrite, TaskCreate and TaskUpdate rows in the transcript; ctrl+o still shows them
